items.excerpt: Leaked specs for Samsung's Android XR Galaxy Glasses point to a Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 chip, dual cameras and deep Gemini integration for hands-free AI capture, translation and navigation ahead of Unpacked.

Samsung's official teaser frames the Galaxy Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2 as 'AI-powered health companions,' promising real-time on-device health insights, a personal health coach and new Vitals tracking.
A pre-Unpacked leak details the Galaxy Watch 9 and Ultra 2 colors, specs and AI-driven health features, including new internal components tuned for longer, more accurate on-device health monitoring.
Samsung officially confirms the Galaxy Watch 9 as an AI health companion, teasing a personalized health coach, Vitals, Heart Health Score and sleep apnea tracking built on on-device intelligence.
Gemini for Home redesigns how the Nest Hub renders weather and general-knowledge answers on-screen, part of Google's push to make its AI smart-display assistant more visual and reliable.
One UI 9 debuts Gemini Intelligence on Galaxy devices, adding agentic automation that acts across apps, plus AI features like text-prompt widget creation, smarter autofill and voice-to-text Rambler.
A Google Home update improves Gemini's reliability on speakers and displays, reducing mid-conversation cutoffs and adding smarter sports and continued-conversation handling for the AI assistant.
After testing several Snapdragon X2 Elite systems, Notebookcheck compares the 80-TOPS Hexagon NPU AI PCs against the latest Intel and AMD laptops on performance and efficiency.
Review of Microsoft's Surface Laptop 13.8 (2026) built on the Snapdragon X2 Plus, a Copilot+ AI PC with a much faster CPU and an NPU that clears Microsoft's on-device AI requirements.
